hookups.source: https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=GA&parkId=530146 (site details of all 44 'Campsite Electric' sites: 'Electricity Hookup: 30', 'Water Hookup: Y'; sewer only at the two host-designated sites 14 and 35), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 44 electric RV/tent sites; per-site max vehicle length 20 ft at 20 of them, 30 ft at 12, 40 ft at 8, 50 ft at 4 (sites 05, 11, 36, 38), so 24 sites take a 23-ft rig. Site 08 is the only pull-through. Sites 14 and 35 are marked Host. 12 walk-in and 4 backcountry tent sites besides.

sites.source: https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=GA&parkId=530146 (every site's Max Vehicle Length / Driveway Entry); https://gastateparks.org/BlackRockMountain ('44 Tent, Trailer & RV Campsites', '12 Walk-In Campsites', '4 Backcountry Campsites'), read 2026-10-29

booking.source: https://gastateparks.org/BlackRockMountain ('Make a Reservation' -> Georgia State Parks' ReserveAmerica site; every campsite bookable there), read 2026-10-29

values.note: $36 a night for an electric/water back-in site, $38 for the pull-through (site 08) and the two host-designated sites; the same on a weekday and a Saturday (November 2026, June 2027). Walk-in tent sites $25, backcountry $20. Vehicles need the $10 ParkPass. Read 2026-10-29.

fees.source: https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=GA&parkId=530146 (1-night prices for every site on 2027-06-16; sites 05 and 08 also on 2026-11-10 and 2027-06-19: $36.00 and $38.00 Per Night), read 2026-10-29

note: Georgia's highest state park (3,640 ft). The park says RVers should be comfortable driving on steep, winding roads, and that it may close during icy weather.
summary: Confirmed on gastateparks.org + ReserveAmerica: 44 electric sites (30 A, water; sewer only at 2 host sites), per-site lengths 20-50 ft with 24 sites taking 23 ft, one pull-through; $36 (pull-through $38) weekday and Saturday, ParkPass $10; phone and pin OK. Added hookups, max length, deep booking link. Facilities left (park page silent). Note: dropped site count, hookups, bathhouse/laundry/dump and ReserveAmerica text; kept the steep-roads and icy-weather warnings.
flags: Website lists three URLs; the bare https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com is redundant beside the parkId=530146 deep link. Suggest https://gastateparks.org/BlackRockMountain plus the deep link.
Only 24 of the 44 electric sites take a 23-ft rig (20 sites are capped at 20 ft); booking must pick a site with Max Vehicle Length 30+.
